| ~261 | "Significance testing for a correlation such as $\rho$ determine the extent to which we thing the value of is deviant from zero." | Several things wrong at once — "determine" should agree with the singular subject, "thing" should be "think," and "the value of is deviant" is missing a noun (probably "$\rho$"). | ~303 | "For the Spearman test with small numbers of samples, an approximation of the $t$ test is used... For larger sample size tests using Spearman, an approximation using the $t$ test can be used." | Both the small-sample and large-sample cases are described as using the $t$-approximation, which reads as a contradiction — normally small samples would use an exact/permutation approach and large samples the $t$-approximation.
